proof_body:
by
  intro K _inst1 V _inst3 _inst4 _inst5 n b f a
  exact
    by
      constructor
      · intro h; ext i j; by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, h, hij]
      · intro h i
        have hf : f = Matrix.toLin b b (Matrix.diagonal a) := by rw [← h, Matrix.toLin_toMatrix]
        rw [hf]
        exact (hasEigenvector_toLin_diagonal a i b).apply_eq_smul
target_source: ∀ {K : Type*} [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) K V) (f : V →ₗ[K] V) (a : Fin n → K), (∀ i, f (b i) = a i • b i) ↔ LinearMap.toMatrix b b f = Matrix.diagonal a
